headline: Break today or pay for weeks
summary: You're gaining 0.61 kg/week; need to lose 0.86 kg/week—today closes the 1.47 kg/week gap with zero compromise on food or movement.
details: Huel for breakfast and lunch, whole-food dinner—nothing else enters your mouth today; no snacking, no extras. Row 45 minutes this morning, 30 minutes on the treadmill tonight; movement is non-negotiable. Today you stop bleeding momentum; Tuesday discipline is the foundation for June's goal.
